name: p31_public931_replica_f0
title: Biohub P31 Public931 Replica F0
purpose: FACT-0377: the public kernel reported at 0.931 is our code lineage and differs from the P24/P28 champion by ENVIRONMENT ONLY - every path it uses is already in our P28 control notebook. Its two substantive additions are association-DISCRIMINATION mechanisms our champion leaves off: a secondary model blended by low_margin_consensus (consulted only where the primary is uncertain AND the two agree on the top parent) and bidirectional harmonic-probability fusion at 0.15. It also runs a tighter ILP (disappearance 2.0, division 1.2) with gap-2 recovery and adaptive short-track rescue on. This replicates that configuration as a LOEO control on the honest folds so it can be compared against the P28 champion baselines (FACT-0345) BEFORE any submission is considered. It converges with our own evidence: FACT-0368 puts 87% of the fold-0 gap in association and FACT-0376 shows the binding constraint is discrimination rather than candidate availability - which is exactly what both added mechanisms change. No submission.

provenance.interaction_warning: The three radii and C1/C2/C3 filters are one coupled treatment. Do not ablate or submit C3 alone; local GT shows that would discard about half of true divisions. The P3 harmonic association surface can change which nodes are orphans, so the public +0.013 is evidence for the mechanism family, not a guaranteed additive delta on P3.
